name: GOV extended: ReservePaused (Aave V3 PoolConfigurator)
description: Aave V3 PoolConfigurator: ReservePaused(address,bool) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity high. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
